**Help hospitals deploy, operate and get the most from UNEEG software solutions

**_At UNEEG Medical, we are on a clear mission: improve epilepsy care and enhance patients' quality of life through objective, real-world EEG data. UNEEG EpiSight Solution, our sub-cutaneous EEG monitoring solution enables remote monitoring of brain activity in people with uncontrolled epilepsy and is already making an impact across Europe and the US. We combine the agility of a small company with the high standards of the medical device industry.

_**Your role and team:

**We are looking for an Application/IT Supporter who will be responsible for the technical deployment, support and ongoing operation of UNEEG's software solutions. You will help onboard new hospital customers, with a primary focus on the US market, while ensuring excellent service and operational continuity for our existing customers.

You will initially be part of Technology and later join the new Customer Enablement & Governance team. Working closely with the Project Lead, Customer Enablement & Governance, you will be the technical bridge between hospital IT teams and colleagues across Commercial, Clinical Operations and Technology. The role includes both remote and on-site support, and travel can be expected.

**Your main responsibilities will be:

**

• Plan, install, configure and test data transfer infrastructure solutions in hospitals

• Provide remote and on-site support for installations, upgrades, operation and troubleshooting

• Train hospital IT staff and system administrators to maintain deployed solutions effectively

• Monitor and maintain hospital servers, cloud clients and Microsoft Azure environments

• Troubleshoot networking, data communication, application and system performance issues

• Configure and manage virtual machines, containers and Kubernetes environments, and deploy patches and updates

• Document support cases and technical issues in Jira and collaborate with software developers on resolution and product improvements

• Maintain deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides and other technical documentation in line with healthcare IT and data security requirements

**You will thrive in this role if you:

**

• Are service-minded, outgoing and persistent, and enjoy working directly with customers

• Take ownership, follow up rigorously and solve problems before they arise

• Can manage several tasks at the same time while staying structured and attentive to detail

• Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Enjoy collaborating across commercial, clinical and software development teams

• Are flexible when customer needs occasionally require support across time zones or outside normal working hours

**Your background:

**

• An education as an IT Support Technician or Data Technician, ideally focused on infrastructure, or a relevant degree in software development, infrastructure or a related field

• Experience or strong interest in customer-facing technical service or IT support; newly educated candidates with the right mindset are also encouraged to apply

• Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, virtualization and container-based environments, including Kubernetes

• Knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server, and scripting

• Ability to troubleshoot networking, application and system performance issues

• Experience with defect tracking and monitoring tools, such as Jira, Prometheus, Grafana or Azure Monitor

• Fluent professional English, both written and spoken

**It will be an advantage if you have experience with:

**

• Healthcare IT, hospital environments or deployment in public-sector organizations

• Healthcare data standards, hospital IT security protocols or clinical trial workflows

• ITIL or similar service management methodologies

• Data protection and privacy requirements, including GDPR and HIPAA

• Supporting international customers in Europe or the US

• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Kubernetes Administrator

Applicants must be eligible to work in Denmark and possess a valid work and residence permit if applicable. At this time, we are unable to support work permit applications or sponsorships.

**What we offer:

**

• A key role in supporting secure and scalable customer solutions in a growing medical device company

• Close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international hospital stakeholders

• A workplace with great energy, social activities and a culture of togetherness

• A role based at our modern HQ in Allerød with good facilities and easy access

At UNEEG, your ideas matter, your work makes a difference, and your colleagues have your back.

**Who to contact:

**For more details about the job, please contact Senior Director, Technology, Kim Heegaard Hansen at +45 25 65 75 01.

**How to apply:

**Apply through our Careers site.

All applications must be in English and are treated confidentially. We screen applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About UNEEG Medical

**UNEEG Medical pioneers ultra long-term subcutaneous EEG monitoring to help physicians optimize treatment for epilepsy patients. Our UNEEG EpiSight solution provides objective insights into seizure burden, enabling more personalized care. We collaborate with leading institutions across Europe and the US to help patients regain control of their life. At UNEEG Medical, we are currently 40 dedicated people with diverse backgrounds. Our HQ is in Allerød with subsidiaries in the UK, Germany, Austria and the US. Our core values Togetherness, Integrity, and Dedication guide our work as we catalyze brain health therapy with real-world data.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Manager of Automation & IT Project Management at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by leading people and complex technical projects and you thrive in a changing, multidisciplinary environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Manager of AIT Project Management to join our AIT Project Management leadership team. As a team, we are working on some of the largest and most technically complex pharma projects in Denmark, using the latest technologies across Automation and IT.

Together with the AIT Project Management leadership team, you will lead and develop a department of 15 Project Managers delivering highly technical projects in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. Your contribution will be important in ensuring high performance and employee wellbeing, while securing the right resources and competencies for our growing project portfolio.

You will work closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support business development, follow up on new opportunities and ensure the right staffing across our projects. You will also contribute to creating a positive and engaging working environment across our wider team of more than 50 highly skilled Project Managers.

Our Project Managers bring experience across Process Automation, SCADA, PLC, IT/OT, PI, PAT, MES, and automated solutions. Project execution ranges from traditional PMP-based planning and execution to agile methodologies and the use of ADO, depending on the project area and customer requirements.

How you might spend your days

As a Manager of AIT Project Management, you’ll be:

• Leading, coaching, and developing a motivated team of Project Managers, ensuring high employee engagement and wellbeing

• Ensuring the right resources and competence mix are in place to support our growth strategy and project pipeline

• Working closely with Project Directors, customers, and Sales to support project delivery, business development, and new opportunities

• Strengthening Project Management processes within AIT and driving continuous improvements

• Supporting project execution and, when needed, taking on smaller assignments as a Project Manager

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A supportive leader who listens, provides constructive feedback, and motivates others to succeed

• Committed to ongoing coaching and the wellbeing and development of your employees

• A team player who leads by example and collaborates effectively across different areas and levels

• A strong communicator with a positive, holistic, and analytical mindset

• Structured and effective in your work, with an open and engaging management style

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical discipline, or bring equivalent relevant experience

• You have at least four years of experience leading Project Managers and/or technical specialists

• You have a background as a Project Manager

• You have knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry

• You are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact VP of AIT Project Management Timme Traberg-Andersen +45 3079 9436.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Senior Project Manager – Clean & Industrial Utilities

****Location: Hillerød, Denmark

****Department: DPM Expansion – Future QC

**Are you ready to take ownership of a critical utilities workstream within one of Novo's largest quality control expansion projects?

Do you bring strong experience in clean or industrial utilities, combined with a practical understanding of commissioning, qualification and project delivery?

Are you motivated by the opportunity to influence a major Greenfield development, work with experienced engineering specialists and take responsibility for delivering complex technical systems?

If you enjoy combining technical knowledge with project leadership, stakeholder collaboration and practical problem solving, this could be an exciting next step in your career.

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager Clean & Industrial Utilities to join our DPM Expansion – Future QC programme in Hillerod, Denmark.

**The position

**As Senior Project Manager, you will take ownership of the commissioning and qualification planning and coordination for clean and industrial utility systems within our new Future QC facility.

The project represents an investment of approximately DKK 3 billion and involves the construction of a 42,000 m² quality control laboratory facility, the largest of its kind within Novo.

Working within a relatively lean and highly collaborative project organisation, you will have significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a direct impact on how critical utility systems are delivered, qualified and handed over to operations.

A central part of your role will be ensuring that commissioning and qualification activities are effectively planned, coordinated and aligned with construction milestones, equipment installation requirements and phased building handovers.

You will work closely with contractors, engineering specialists, validation colleagues, IT, equipment owners and other project stakeholders to manage technical dependencies, identify risks and ensure the successful progression of the utilities workstream.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead the planning and coordination of commissioning and qualification activities for clean and industrial utility systems.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Work closely with the validation team to establish qualification strategies, timelines, vendor documentation requirements and appropriate levels of technical oversight.

• Coordinate with the main contractor, subcontractors and engineering specialists to ensure utility systems are delivered in accordance with project requirements and relevant standards.

• Manage interfaces and dependencies between utility availability, equipment installation, controlled shutdowns and phased building handovers.

• Review commissioning and qualification plans, identify potential technical or operational risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.

• Engage with equipment owners, IT, engineering and operational stakeholders to understand system requirements and ensure utility availability is aligned with their delivery schedules.

• Provide informed technical recommendations, support decision-making and escalate matters affecting cost, scope or programme timelines through established governance processes.

• Contribute to the successful handover of utility systems to the operational and maintenance organisations.

• Collaborate across the wider project team, supporting other critical workstreams where priorities and project needs require.

• This is a project manager position rather than a detailed engineering design role.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you will bring a strong technical foundation in utility systems, practical experience in regulated operational environments and the ability to manage complex engineering activities.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have developed their careers through technical, maintenance, facilities or operational engineering roles before progressing into project management.

**We Expect You To Have

**

• A relevant educational background in engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical industry experience.

• Strong technical experience in either clean utilities or industrial utilities, particularly piping related systems such as purified water, clean steam, heating, cooling, water distribution or compressed air.

• Demonstrable experience in equipment or systems commissioning, qualification and/or validation, including a sound understanding of controlled processes, documentation and operational requirements.

• Practical experience working within an operational plant, manufacturing facility or similarly complex technical environment, including exposure to maintenance activities, system start ups, shutdowns or equipment qualification.

• Proven experience coordinating engineering projects, technical workstreams, contractors or specialist service providers. Experience working within regulated or process driven industries where safety, quality, documentation and controlled operating procedures are essential.

• Strong planning, coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and technical dependencies.

• The ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

• Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology or other GMP regulated environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

• We also welcome relevant experience from industries such as food and beverage, chemical manufacturing, oil and gas, and engineering or EPC organisations, provided you bring the necessary utilities and qualification expertise.

• Experience across both clean and industrial utilities would be beneficial; however, strong expertise in either discipline is sufficient.

• Knowledge of Science and Risk-Based Validation (SRV), commissioning and qualification methodologies, and large-scale CAPEX or Greenfield projects would also be advantageous.

**About The Department

**

• You will join the DPM Expansion Future QC programme in Hillerod, where we are delivering a major new quality control laboratory facility to support Novo's expanding manufacturing capabilities.

• The programme involves the development of approximately 42,000 m² of new laboratory and supporting infrastructure, representing a significant investment in the future of our quality control operations.

• The project is currently progressing through construction, with commissioning, qualification and phased handover activities forming critical elements of the delivery programme.

• Our engineering organisation is relatively lean, bringing together specialists across utilities, validation, engineering, technical interfaces and other essential project disciplines.

• This structure provides an opportunity for individuals to take genuine ownership of their responsibilities, work closely with experienced colleagues and influence important technical and operational decisions.

We value collaboration, practical problem solving and the willingness to take responsibility. While you will lead your own workstream, you will also be part of a team that supports one another and responds flexibly as project priorities evolve.

Joining us means contributing to a technically challenging Greenfield project where your experience, judgement and decisions will make a visible difference.

**About You

**

• You are an experienced technical professional who combines a strong understanding of utility systems with the ability to plan, coordinate and deliver complex project activities.

• You understand what it takes to commission, qualify and operate technical systems in real world environments, and you appreciate the importance of controlled procedures, thorough planning and effective communication.

• You are comfortable working with experienced engineering specialists and contractors, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions constructively and bringing stakeholders together to find practical solutions.

• You take ownership of your responsibilities and are confident making recommendations, while recognising when issues require wider discussion or escalation.

• You are also adaptable and pragmatic.

• You understand that priorities can change within major construction programmes and are willing to support colleagues and other workstreams when needed.

• Above all, you enjoy being close to the technical and operational realities of a project and take pride in helping complex systems move successfully from construction through qualification and into operation.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Our commitment to defeating serious chronic diseases is built on more than a century of innovation, collaboration and a determination to make a meaningful difference to people's lives.

Joining our Future QC expansion programme offers the opportunity to contribute to a major investment in our manufacturing and quality control capabilities, while developing your experience within a global organisation undertaking complex engineering and expansion projects.

You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, influence the delivery of a significant Greenfield development and contribute to infrastructure that will support our operations for years to come.

**Working at Novo

**Every day, we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with an unconventional spirit, a determination to innovate and a commitment to creating lasting change.

Working at Novo means joining a global healthcare company where talented people collaborate across disciplines, challenge established thinking and pursue solutions that can improve the lives of millions.

When you join us, you're not just starting a job you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**Salary And Benefits

**The salary range for this position is DKK 742,600 to DKK 1,091,600 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

**Incentives And Benefits

**Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce.

We offer an environment where you can develop professionally, take on meaningful challenges and build your career within a global organisation committed to innovation and long term progress.

Our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind, supporting your professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes we're creating lasting change for long term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives.

This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to explore new possibilities, challenge conventions and push the boundaries of what is possible.

Together, we're life changing.

SENIOR MECHANICAL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

Join our product development team

Mechanical Product Development • Robust Design • Plastics • From Design To Production-ready Product

Location: Allerød, north of Copenhagen • Function: R&D / Product Development

Do you enjoy the engineering disciplines that turn a good mechanical design into a robust product design that works reliably in the real world?

Qufora is a growing, design-focused medical device company. We develop intuitive products that help people with chronic bowel disorders live a more fulfilled life.

We have a relatively small and flat organisation, which means short distances from idea to decision and from decision to action. You will be close to the products, the technical decisions and the people who make them—with the opportunity to influence both the engineering solutions and how we work.

The engineering role

This is a role for someone who enjoys the fundamentals of good mechanical engineering and knows how to combine them into robust design solutions. Understanding variation and sensitivity to design products that perform consistently despite real-world variation in components, materials, processes and use.

• Interface & mechanical design – create well-defined interfaces and mechanically sound solutions without unnecessary constraints or complexity.

• Tolerances & GPS/GD&T – translate functional needs into meaningful dimensions and tolerances, using tolerance stack-ups and statistical tolerancing where relevant.

• Mechanics & structural integrity – apply solid mechanics, engineering calculations and FEA where appropriate to understand loads, deformation, strength, fatigue and failure modes.

• Materials & plastics – select materials based on function, environment, manufacturing process and long-term product performance.

• DFM/DFA & injection moulding – develop designs that can be manufactured and assembled consistently and at the required quality, working closely with toolmakers, suppliers and Operations.

• Variation & statistical analysis – use data and statistical methods to understand variation, identify critical parameters and build robustness into the design.

You will not be placed in a narrow technical box. Depending on the challenge, you may move from CAD and tolerance analysis to material selection, supplier discussions, FEA, design reviews, verification results or solving a difficult mechanical problem in an existing product.

What you will do

You will take senior technical ownership of mechanical development activities, particularly in the later stages of product development.

You will:

• Develop and mature mechanical solutions from established concepts through detailed design, verification, design transfer and launch.

• Create high-quality 3D designs and clear, production-ready 2D drawings.

• Drive difficult mechanical issues to root cause and closure.

• Work hands-on with plastics, injection-moulded components, interfaces, tolerances, materials and robust design.

• Work closely with Operations, external manufacturers, suppliers and toolmakers to turn designs into stable, manufacturable products.

• Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering activities when several people or disciplines need to contribute.

• Help strengthen our mechanical engineering methods, standards and ways of working.

What we are looking for

You have a BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development or a similar discipline and at least 8 years of experience in mechanical product development.

Ideally, you bring several of the following:

• Strong mechanical design fundamentals and engineering judgement.

• Experience with plastic product design and injection moulding.

• Advanced 3D CAD and 2D drawing skills, preferably SolidWorks.

• Strong knowledge of ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerance analysis and robust design.

• Experience with DFM/DFA, materials, mechanics and preferably FEA.

• Experience taking products from detailed development through verification and into production.

• The ability to structure complex technical work and drive issues to completion.

Experience from medical devices or another regulated industry is an advantage, but first and foremost, we are looking for a strong mechanical product developer.

Why Qufora?

At Qufora, you will work broadly across mechanical engineering disciplines and follow products through the development process rather than being limited to one narrow area. You will be close to the products, colleagues and decisions, with the opportunity to influence both engineering solutions and how we work. And because we develop medical devices, your engineering decisions ultimately matter to people who rely on our products every day.

Application

Please apply through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held on an ongoing basis.

We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned Logistics Procurement Category Manager to join the Group Procurement function at Royal Unibrew.

• Energised by challenges, white spaces, and complexity.

• Passion for developing and coaching teams.

The successful candidate will establish strong Group category governance while enabling local ownership, build strategic supplier partnerships, increase data and digital maturity, strengthen resilience and sustainability, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the total cost, service and efficiency of Royal Unibrew's logistics network.

Do you enjoy leading complex development projects and coordinating work across internal teams and external development partners? Then you may be the Project Manager we are looking for in EndoIntelligence Solutions within Global R&D.

In this role, you will lead a strategically important development project and work closely with a global and cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution from planning through delivery.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Project Manager, you will:

• Drive project planning, execution, follow-up, and reporting of scope, timeline, budget, risks, and key decisions.

• Coordinate activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director, you will bring a strong commercial perspective and shape the long-term forecasts that guide brand, portfolio and corporate decisions within Blood & Endocrine (formerly Rare Disease). Your recommendations will help senior leaders decide where to invest, so promising science reaches more patients living with rare, serious chronic diseases. Your work starts influencing real decisions from day one.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for someone who combines scientific understanding and commercial insight with rigorous analysis and can turn complexity into clear recommendations. You bring:

• A Master’s or PhD in business, economics, medicine, biology or pharmacy.

• 8–10 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry or similar experience from a top management consultancy.

• Experience developing global and local forecasts integrating epidemiological, market, clinical, and competitive assumptions.

• Experience working across the pharma value chain (e.g., clinical development, market access, commercial) to assess an early-stage assets’ clinical and commercial value.

• Strong commercial understanding and a solid grounding in natural science.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build clear frameworks from limited data.

• Strong understanding of financial valuation methodologies and value drivers for pharmaceutical assets.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Direct experience in forecasting, new product planning, and asset valuations.

• Experience working with Rare Disease, especially in endocrine, musculoskeletal, and/or renal diseases.

**What You’ll Do

**You will play a leading role across two connected areas: New Product Planning and Forecasting. Working across assigned assets and therapy areas, you will turn complex clinical, market and competitive insights into clear recommendations that guide development and investment decisions.

**You Will

**

• Own New Product Planning & Forecasting wholistically for one or two therapeutic areas within the Blood & Endocrine

• Drive Target Product Profile development for early-stage assets working in close collaboration with the Global Project Teams.

• Lead project valuations and risk assessments for pipeline assets at critical gate passages

• Own the long-term forecast process and outcome, challenging local market assumptions and deliver realistic and ambitious forecasts.

• Develop scenarios that reveal the key value drivers, opportunities and risks, and translate them into clear actions for brands and senior management.

• Provide robust, fact-based decision support to Global Project Teams and senior leaders, ensuring alignment between commercial, clinical and regulatory strategies.

**Who You’ll Work With

**In Product & Portfolio Strategy, colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas, helping guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will join the New Product Planning & Forecasting team within Commercial Excellence & Strategic Planning in Blood & Endocrine, reporting to the Director of NPP & Forecasting.

Your work is global in reach. You will partner closely with multiple teams across the organization, both at local and regional level – as well as with external vendors and consultants. Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity, secure buy-in and help decisions move at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in a high-trust environment with a high level of independence and empowerment to make decisions on your daily work. The role offers cross value chain exposure across commercial, medical, research and supply, and the chance to influence choices that shape the future of the portfolio. You will be trusted to raise the bar, mentor others and grow your commercial and analytical expertise.

**_Salary

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn analysis into decisions that shape a portfolio and progress for people living with rare, serious chronic diseases, apply for the New Product Planning & Forecasting Associate Director role by November 6th, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: HR Business Partner, Strategic Marketing and International Sales
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HR Business Partner who thrives in a dynamic international environment? Do you enjoy partnering with senior leaders, translating business priorities into people strategies, and driving organisational effectiveness through strong HR partnering? And are you motivated by supporting commercial organisations where leadership, talent and culture play a critical role in business success? Then you might be our new HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales at Demant Diagnostics.

Driving people and business success across Strategic Marketing and International Sales

As HR Business Partner for Strategic Marketing and International Sales, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and leadership teams, helping translate strategy into practical people and organisational solutions. You will support two business functions, each led by its own Vice President and operating with different priorities, organisational structures and ways of working.

In this role, you will partner closely with leaders to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability, employee engagement and business performance. You will be responsible for ensuring that people priorities are closely aligned with business goals while supporting the execution of the broader Diagnostics and global Demant people agenda.

Meet your new team and manager

The Diagnostics HR team acts as a close partner to leaders and the organisation, enabling strong performance, development and engagement across our global Diagnostics business. We work at the intersection of people, business and organisational development, ensuring that HR initiatives create value for both leaders and employees.

Our team values trust, development and continuous improvement. We combine strategic HR partnering with pragmatic execution and take pride in delivering professional, high-quality support across a diverse and international organisation.

The position is reporting to Kirsten Schmidt, Senior Director Diagnostics HR, and is based at the Demant Diagnostics Headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen. We offer flexibility to work from home when business needs and tasks allow.

Global HR partnering supporting a growing business area

The HR Business Partner will play a key role in supporting leaders through organisational changes, helping navigate complexity, manage stakeholder expectations and create sustainable business solutions.

You will collaborate with HR colleagues and business stakeholders across functions, countries and organisational levels to ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR initiatives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Partner closely with the Vice Presidents and leadership teams within Strategic Marketing and International Sales

• Act as a trusted advisor and sparring partner on leadership, organisational and people-related matters

• Coach and challenge leaders to strengthen leadership effectiveness and team performance

• Drive and support organisational development, capability building and change initiatives

• Drive and facilitate initiatives to ensure alignment between business priorities and global HR processes.

• Lead talent and succession discussions, supporting the identification, development and retention of key capabilities

• Use people insights and workforce data to support informed decision-making and organisational planning

In addition, you will support organisational reviews, workforce planning and employee engagement initiatives while contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Your qualifications & experience

**

We imagine that you will bring a combination of:

• Solid experience as an HR Business Partner supporting leaders and commercial organisations in a complex business environment

• Relevant degree within human resources, business administration, organisational psychology or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience advising and influencing leaders on organisational, talent and people matters

• Experience driving organisational change, leadership development and talent management initiatives

• Strong understanding of core HR disciplines and employment practices

• Experience working in an international and matrix-based organisation

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Experience supporting senior leaders or executives

Bringing solid business acumen, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to all your stakeholders will provide you with a great foundation for this role. Furthermore, you are comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational execution and have the confidence to challenge constructively while building trusted relationships across the organisation.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to join a global organisation where people, leadership and business performance are closely connected. You will work with experienced leaders, influence strategic people agendas and contribute to shaping the future organisation across Strategic Marketing and International Sales.

Ready to join Demant Diagnostic’s HR team?

**Join Trackman’s R&D team and help create world-leading sports tracking solutions

**We are looking for an experienced Electronics Engineer to join our Hardware R&D team and contribute to the development of the next generation of radar- and vision-based products.

At Trackman, we continuously push the boundaries of sports technology. Our products combine radar, computer vision, embedded electronics, and software to deliver market-leading performance analysis solutions used by athletes and organizations worldwide. As part of our Hardware R&D team, you will play a key role in designing and validating advanced electronic solutions that power our innovative products.

**The role

**As an Electronics Engineer, you will work closely with talented colleagues across electronics, mechanics, optics, software, tracking, and production. You will contribute to the development of robust and high-performance hardware solutions from concept through verification and production. This is a hands-on engineering role where technical expertise, curiosity, and collaboration are essential.

**What Will You Be Doing

**

• Develop and verify high- and low-speed digital circuits, including Computer Modules, FPGAs, camera sensors (CMOS), high-performance ADCs and DACs, microcontrollers (MCUs), USB and LAN controllers, and power management ICs.

• Design and develop DC power supply and power management circuits, ensuring efficient and reliable power distribution across hardware platforms.

• Work with DC/DC converter topologies such as Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost, SEPIC, Flyback, and Forward converters.

• Perform laboratory testing, signal analysis, verification, and debugging using oscilloscopes, signal generators, and other advanced measurement equipment.

• Participate in schematic design, PCB layout reviews, stack-up definition, and constraint-driven multilayer PCB development.

• Use simulation tools such as LTspice to validate and optimize designs before hardware implementation.

• Collaborate with mechanical, optical, software, and manufacturing teams to ensure designs meet product requirements and are optimized for production.

• Support production and quality teams in troubleshooting hardware-related issues and implementing improvements to increase product robustness and manufacturing yield.

• Contribute to technical discussions, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives across the hardware organization.

**Job Requirements

****What are we looking for?

**

• Bachelor or Master in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 5+ years of experience developing electronic products and working with design-for-manufacture principles.

• Strong understanding of digital and analog electronics, PCB design, and electronic components.

• Experience with simulation tools such as LTspice or equivalent.

• Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and signal generators.

• Experience developing power management and DC/DC converter solutions is considered an advantage.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to problem solving.

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical topics clearly.

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements affecting electronic product development.

**The Office

**We are located in our state-of-the-art HQ at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the building we designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness centre, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

**For additional information about the position, please contact our Electronics Team Lead, Søren Seehusen, at sts@trackman.com . Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

• join the CMC Life Cycle Management (LCM) Team and support our growing portfolio of commercial products globally.

**Requirements

**

• 4+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry, preferably within manufacturing operations, lifecycle, product management for commercial products.

• Experience in building relations and influencing multi-functional teams within multicultural organizations.

• Experience managing and defining project coordination activities and tasks in a structured, regulated environment.

• Prior experience with commercial product lifecycle management and oversight of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is considered an advantage.

• Broad understanding of global cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations across major markets

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural environments

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, balance competing demands, and deliver against project timelines

• Team player with the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

DKK597.312,00---895.968,00

jobs.occupation: BIOLOGIST - DHI MUSE AND AVIAN ECOLOGY
jobs.description:
Do you want to lead the ecological interpretation of complex offshore bird-monitoring projects? Can you turn radar, video, acoustic and environmental data into scientifically defensible conclusions for clients and regulators? Join DHI and take scientific ownership of projects at the intersection of avian ecology, technology and offshore wind.

Responsibilities and challenges

We are looking for a Biologist to support the scientific delivery of DHI MUSE and avian ecology projects. You will contribute to biological reviews, ecological analyses, reporting, and project coordination, working with experienced biologists, data scientists, instrumentation specialists and project managers. You will take increasing ownership of routine project-level scientific tasks, with guidance from senior colleagues and the Scientific Lead.

Your main responsibilities and challenges will include:

• Prepare, organise and analyse radar, video, acoustic, weather and system-status data needed for scientific deliverables.

• Contribute to ecological analyses of flight trajectories, bird flux, species distribution, phenology, avoidance behaviour and collision risk.

• Work with data scientists and analysts to review results and interpret them in their ecological context.

• Draft report sections, technical notes, presentations, figures, tables and responses to review comments.

• Document assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and other performance aspects clearly and consistently.

• Participate in project meetings and support communication with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and other DHI teams.

• Follow approved methods and quality procedures, and escalate unsupported conclusions or non-standard methods to senior colleagues.

Qualifications and personal skills

We are looking for a colleague with the following qualifications:

Required:

• Master's degree in biology, ecology, ornithology or a closely related discipline, equivalent relevant qualifications or other proven merits and references in ornithology.

• A strong foundation in avian ecology, species identification, animal behaviour, migration ecology or environmental monitoring.

• Ability to analyse scientific information and communicate findings clearly in writing and orally.

• Careful and consistent approach to biological classification, quality assurance and documentation.

• Good data-handling skills and willingness to work with radar, video, acoustic and environmental datasets.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Ability to collaborate across biological, analytical, technical and project-management disciplines.

• Ability to use AI to speed up delivery without loss of quality.

Desirable:

• Relevant professional, internship, thesis or research experience in bird monitoring, ecological consultancy or offshore wind.

• Experience reviewing wildlife video or acoustic recordings, identifying birds, or working with behavioural annotations.

• Experience in R, Python or other tools used for data analysis.

• Knowledge of environmental impact assessment, collision-risk modelling or remote-sensing methods.

Personal qualities:

• Curious, methodical and keen to learn.

• Self-motivated and comfortable asking for guidance when needed.

• Strong attention to detail and scientific integrity.

• Collaborative, service-minded and able to communicate with colleagues from different disciplines.

We offer

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that addresses complex challenges in water and the environment. We will offer you:

• A role where ecological science is applied directly to offshore wind and environmental decision-making.

• Collaboration with biologists, data scientists, analysts, instrumentation specialists and project managers.

• Professional and personal development, with room to grow your scientific and client-facing responsibilities.

• Flexible working opportunities.

• A diverse, international network of highly skilled colleagues.

• The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of DHI MUSE and avian ecology services.

About DHI and DHI MUSE

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE and MUSE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team.

DHI MUSE specifically is dedicated to managing the interplay between avian fauna and offshore wind energy. The product and associated work ultimately aim to automate bird monitoring, and as an add-on do curtailment of specific turbines when there is a risk of collision.

By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices.

Office location

• The position is based at DHI's office in Hørsholm, Denmark, with flexible working opportunities in accordance with DHI policy.

How to apply

• Please submit your application and CV via the relevant job posting on DHI Careers.

• Application deadline: 2026-11-10.

• For further information, please contact Måns Karlsson, Scientific Lead, moka@dhigroup.com, +45 4516 9146.

**Create Solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**

**Are you motivated by working with complex commercial contracts, legal risk management and major construction and infrastructure projects in an international environment? Do you enjoy combining strong legal expertise with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach to support decision-making and deliver practical solutions? And do you thrive in a collaborative role where you can build relationships across a global organization? Then COWI could be the right place for you.

**

To support our business in Denmark and internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby, Denmark. As an international consultancy, COWI delivers engineering, architecture, energy and environmental solutions across the globe. We contribute to some of the world's most significant and sustainable projects, and our legal team plays an important role in enabling our business, managing legal and commercial risks, and supporting successful project delivery.

You will join the Danish legal team, consisting of four senior legal counsels and two paralegals, and become part of COWI's Group Legal function. Group Legal comprises 25 team members based in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK, Ireland and Canada, providing comprehensive legal support across COWI's business lines.

This position is ideal for an experienced legal professional who enjoys working hands-on with complex contractual matters, negotiating commercial agreements and supporting large construction and infrastructure projects. Your key responsibilities

• Structuring, drafting and negotiating consultancy agreements, framework agreements, joint venture agreements, memoranda of understanding, teaming agreements and other commercial contracts.

• Advising on contract management, claims management and the identification, assessment and mitigation of legal and commercial risks.

• Reviewing and negotiating contracts for large and complex construction and infrastructure projects, including agreements based on ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke contractual terms.

• Advising on disputes and settlement negotiations, including instructing and coordinating external legal counsel.

• Supporting, training and guiding line managers and senior management on legal matters, including contracts, public procurement, competition law, intellectual property rights and data protection.

• Supporting corporate housekeeping and advising on legal compliance matters.

• Providing legal support for mergers and acquisitions and other strategic business initiatives.

• Contributing to the continuous improvement and development of COWI's standard contract templates and legal processes.

**Your skills. Our teams. Together we design the future.

**

At COWI, collaboration is essential. We value professionals who build strong relationships, take ownership, and contribute with both technical expertise and a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset. You are proactive, curious and motivated to continuously improve how legal support is delivered across the organization.

On top of that, you will have:

• A Danish Master's degree in Law.

• Experience from a law firm and/or an in-house legal function.

• Extensive experience in contractual review and negotiation, including ABR 18, AB 18, FIDIC and bespoke forms of agreements.

• A strong understanding of legal and commercial risk management, with the ability to identify, assess and mitigate contractual risks.

• Strong drafting and communication skills in both Danish and English.

• Excellent analytical skills and the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, concise and commercially relevant advice for legal and non-legal stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented approach, balancing attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of complex legal matters and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.

• A collaborative mindset and an interest in working as part of a specialist legal team supporting a large international organization.

• Experience working in an international environment would be an advantage.

**A place to work and so much more.

**

At COWI, we collaborate with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow.

We support our customers' transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to set a positive standard by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the solutions we provide for our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun, because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we bring together expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and the environment to create lasting impact.

**Got More Questions?

**

If you have any questions about the role or what we have to offer, please contact Head of Legal Denmark, Kit Bækgaard at kich@cowi.com or Senior Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you're interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths.

We take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting up teams and forums. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

We are seeking a Financial Controller to own the integrity of Tekla’s financial reporting across the group. The role combines technical control work, balance sheet reconciliations, consolidation and eliminations, with ownership of a growing set of tax and trade compliance obligations spanning packaging tax, EU and global VAT and customs duties.

The Financial Controller is responsible both for meeting these obligations accurately and on time, and for building the processes, controls and automation that make them repeatable as the business scales. The role sits within an AI-first function focused on operational excellence, so we are looking for someone with a strong digital mindset and a proactive approach to using AI and automation tools to enhance reporting and improve efficiency.

This is a hands-on role, instrumental in ensuring financial accuracy and supporting Tekla's profitability and growth objectives. Reporting to the Finance Director and working closely with the Accounting Manager, the Financial Controller will also contribute to a range of ad hoc financial projects and initiatives across the function.

This is a full-time position based in our open-plan, curated office in Copenhagen.

Key responsibilities of the role include, but are not limited to:

Financial Controlling & Reporting

• Design, implement and manage the group's balance sheet reconciliations, including building standardised templates and processes across multiple entities

• Prepare the monthly and year-end group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and consolidated reporting packs

• Ensure the general ledger is supported by complete, reviewed and documented reconciliations in every period. While taking a hands-on approach to booking journals and ad hoc analysis

Tax & Trade Compliance

• Own end-to-end packaging tax obligations, including data capture, calculation and filing

• Perform compliance reviews over packaging tax, taking a proactive approach as Tekla's global footprint grows

• Analyse customs and import duties, covering tariff classification, country of origin, preferential rates and duty paid versus duty due, and identify recovery and savings opportunities.

Financial Analysis & Performance

• Monitor cash flow, working capital, and financial performance metrics

• Perform variance and accuracy analyses to validate forecasts, budgets, and data integrity, encouraging transparency and accountability

• Investigate material variances and implement process improvements that enhance forecasting precision and analytical rigour

• Provide insightful financial analysis to support business planning, cost efficiencies and strategic priorities

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance financial processes, systems, and reporting tools

• Support the automation programme within the accounting team, including Intrastat and VAT reporting

• Review and implement continual improvements in Business Central, including VAT code configuration, VAT statements and financial reports

• Strengthen documentation and controls across all owned processes so they are auditable and transferable

We'd love to hear from you if you are / have:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting standards and tax regulations

• Demonstrable experience of group consolidation and intercompany eliminations in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment

• Strong working knowledge of global VAT and sales tax concepts

• Exposure to packaging tax regimes is an advantage

• Experience designing and operating a balance sheet reconciliation control framework

• Confident ERP user, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• Demonstrable experience using AI tools such as Claude to optimise and automate financial processes and reporting, for example building reporting dashboards, automating reconciliation and compliance workflows, or analysing large transactional data sets

• Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with large transactional data sets

• Experience from a high-growth business within fashion, textiles or luxury consumer goods is an advantage

• An entrepreneurial mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis, with the aim of the successful candidate joining us as soon as possible.
